# Volunteer handbook

The museum and workshop are trialling supported practice for induction. A newcomer works alongside an experienced volunteer during an ordinary shift, including interruptions and fallback decisions. Safety rules still apply. The old compliance training policy remains available, but attendance alone is not a record of what a person has practised.

The key card stays in the secure box. Check exits and floor conditions before opening. A damaged tool belongs in the red tray with an owner and review date. Supported practice must include permission to pause, and name who will help during breaks. [[Maintenance]] holds the fallback decisions. This handbook should help a person act safely in the room rather than make them pass a memory test about it.
